high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a tweet from the Twitter account @TempleTrails. The tweet was posted 15 hours prior to the screenshot being taken at 11:09 AM, as indicated by the timestamp in the top left corner. The battery level is shown as 45%, and the device is connected to LTE with a signal strength indicator. The tweet praises a beautiful sculpture of Bhagwan Vishnu as Lord Varaha, the third avatar of Vishnu, depicted as a boar rescuing Ma Bhu Devi from the depths of the ocean. This sculpture is from the Hoysala Era,
